import_time: import_time.json.gz: mapbuild/import_time.py, one fresh interpreter per module under sqlglot/ and tests/, same image; its 'tests' array lists module roots, not tests

imports.build_command: SKIP_INTEGRATION=0 python mapbuild/import_map.py sample/tests.json <scratch copy of pinned sqlglot> maps -j4 (--recollect redoes only the collection lists)
imports.built: 2026-11-21; full map on laptop (python 3.13.12, same pinned source, same requirements versions). Checked in the pinned image (agent-adv = python:3.13-slim@sha256:e48f59... + requirements.lock, EC2): every 8th test (203) re-traced there gives identical module sets, and identical collection lists. Full image run not done: the shared 4-core box was ~100 min busy.
imports.facts: 1620 tests each run alone, 244 modules, 0 isolation failures; collection: 160 modules (101 by import). No labeled patch used.
imports.environment_note: The only except ImportError around a repo import is sqlglot/_version (generated, not in the repo), so optional dependencies cannot change the module closures.

classes_run: classes_run.json.gz: mapbuild/classes_run.py from trace_one.py traces (r6, same image/sha; every trace's classes equals classes.json.gz): classes minus objects made while a sqlglot/ module body executes

diffexec.what: per sqlglot function: deduplicated call inputs seen while each test ran (inputs over 16 kB with big list/dict/set elided to length-only stand-ins), with a digest of each call's effect (args after the call + result/exception), per (function, test phase) completeness. Built only from the pinned commit's own test run; no labels, patches or mutants. See research/ideas/I12-differential-execution.md (round 8). Round 14: the store zip is kept in the repo as ONE solid xz stream (diffexec/solid.py, functions in source order, 192 MiB dictionary; ~1.8x smaller than per-entry LZMA because functions share inputs); the Docker build expands it to /app/index/diffexec.zip.
diffexec.build_command: mapbuild/diffexec_build.sh (round 14: rebuilt from the round-8 per-file recordings with DIFFEXEC_STORE_BUDGET=27e6 DIFFEXEC_BUILD_BUCKETS=16, then python -m diffexec.solid pack)
diffexec.granularity: one pytest process per test file; caps and the store budget applied after merging
diffexec.jobs: 4, then 2 (RESUME=1) for tests/test_executor.py and tests/test_optimizer.py, whose first run was killed (host memory)
diffexec.record_wall_seconds: about 2,000 (first run, 56 files) + 2,880 (RESUME run, 2 files, shared 4-core host)
diffexec.record_cpu_seconds: not measured over both runs; the RESUME run used 1,911 CPU-s

not_shipped.why: reference-only maps, removed from the repo for the 20 MB limit (r8-diffexec2); mapbuild/build.sh rebuilds them; keys/bytes/sha256 above describe the removed files

dialect_reach: classes.json.gz and classes_run.json.gz then pass through mapbuild/dialect_reach.py <pinned sqlglot> maps (r12): every test recorded for a dialect class is also recorded for each sqlglot class in the MRO of that dialect's tokenizer_class / jsonpath_tokenizer_class / parser_class / generator_class (metaclass-resolved, inherited ones included). Static relation from the pinned source only; adds rows, never removes; idempotent.
